findings.evidence: lock a Member account after 5 consecutive failed login attempts
findings.rationale: Specifies the lockout trigger but omits the lockout duration and unlock/error behavior.
Ambiguous pronoun 'him' could refer to the Librarian, the Member, or the Guarantor.
Uses placeholder 'TBD' instead of a concrete expiration duration.

findings.evidence: user-friendly ... easy to navigate ... loads rapidly
findings.rationale: Subjective, unmeasurable usability and performance terms without quantitative criteria.
Maximum renewal count is left as TBD.

findings.evidence: validate item eligibility ... and issue the loan receipt
findings.rationale: Omits error handling when the barcode is invalid or the item is ineligible for checkout.

findings.evidence: the allowed maximum number of active hold requests
findings.rationale: Fails to specify the numeric maximum hold limit.

findings.evidence: borrow up to 8 physical items simultaneously
findings.rationale: Conflicts with SD-009, which limits active simultaneous loans to at most 5 items.
Conflicts with SD-010, which defines the standard loan duration as 14 calendar days.

findings.evidence: self-register online ... and immediately check out physical books without Librarian ID verification
findings.rationale: Directly contradicts SD-001, which requires in-person Librarian verification of a government-issued photo ID before account creation.

findings.evidence: remain held indefinitely until the requesting Member explicitly cancels
findings.rationale: Directly contradicts SD-011, which mandates automatic cancellation after 72 hours.

findings.evidence: and/or suspend borrowing privileges and/or apply a penalty flag
findings.rationale: Multiple 'and/or' coordinations leave unclear which subset of actions is mandatory.

findings.evidence: shall be reviewed, approved, and recorded
findings.rationale: Passive construction omits the authorized actor responsible for reviewing and approving waivers.
Weak conditional phrase 'if appropriate' leaves trigger conditions and timing undefined.
Retention period is marked as TBD instead of a concrete number of years.

findings.evidence: $1.25 USD per overdue day ... with no maximum cap
findings.rationale: Conflicts with SD-019, which specifies $0.50 USD per day capped at $20.00 USD.

findings.evidence: renew borrowed items online at any time regardless of any unpaid overdue fine balance
findings.rationale: Directly contradicts SD-020, which blocks renewals when unpaid fines exceed $5.00 USD.
Uses 'Patron' instead of the established SRS term 'Member' defined in SD-001 and SD-009.
Unquantified terms 'quickly' and 'many users' lack measurable latency and concurrency thresholds.
Weak phrase 'where possible' makes the requirement non-verifiable and optional without criteria.
Vague qualifiers 'sufficient' and 'acceptable' provide no testable acceptance threshold.
Vague terms 'efficiently', 'large', and 'noticeable' lack concrete volume and latency bounds.
States that the system detects active references but omits what action/consequence follows (block, warn, or cascade).
Backup frequency is unspecified (TBD).
Multiple vague terms leave event scope, latency, and retention period undefined.

findings.evidence: unreachable for more than 10 seconds, the Failover Manager shall log event FAILOVER-01
findings.rationale: Omits the recovery action/timeout when primary database failover occurs.
Vague terms 'adequate' and 'clear' lack concrete protocol and error-format specifications.
Conflicts with SD-002, which requires Member passwords of at least 12 characters.
Conflicts with SD-004, which terminates inactive sessions after 15 minutes.

findings.evidence: reversible AES-256 encryption so Administrators can decrypt and retrieve forgotten passwords
findings.rationale: Directly contradicts SD-003, which mandates one-way bcrypt hashing and forbids storing recoverable passwords.

original_texts.SD-005: The Authentication Service shall lock a Member account for 30 minutes after 5 consecutive failed login attempts within a 10-minute window and display error code ERR-AUTH-LOCK.
original_texts.SD-006: When a Librarian links a Member account to a Guarantor profile, the Notification Service shall send a confirmation email to the Member within 60 seconds and log delivery status.
original_texts.SD-007: The Authentication Service shall expire password-reset tokens exactly 15 minutes after issuance and invalidate any unused token upon a subsequent reset request.
original_texts.SD-008: The Portal Interface shall render the Member dashboard and navigation menu in compliance with WCAG 2.1 Level AA contrast (minimum 4.5:1) and complete initial page load within 1.5 seconds on 10 Mbps links.
original_texts.SD-012: The Circulation System shall allow a Member to renew an eligible loan at most 2 consecutive times provided no other Member has an active hold on that title; ineligible renewals shall return error ERR-RENEW-DENIED.
original_texts.SD-013: When a Member scans an item barcode at a self-checkout kiosk, the Circulation System shall validate item eligibility within 2 seconds and print a receipt; if the barcode is unreadable or the item is reference-only, the kiosk shall display an error alert and abort checkout.
original_texts.SD-014: The Hold Queue Service shall allow each Member to maintain at most 3 active hold requests simultaneously and reject additional requests with message ERR-HOLD-CAP.
original_texts.SD-015: The Circulation System shall restrict standard Members to a maximum of 8 simultaneous physical item checkouts via the online reservation cart.
original_texts.SD-016: The Circulation System shall enforce a 14-day return window for print monographs checked out by Members.
original_texts.SD-017: The Registration Portal shall allow Librarians to pre-register visitors in person prior to ID check.
original_texts.SD-018: The Hold Queue Service shall release uncollected reserved items after 72 hours and notify the Member of cancellation.
original_texts.SD-021: When an item becomes 7 days overdue, the Notification Service shall send an overdue reminder email to the Member and suspend borrowing privileges until the item is returned.
original_texts.SD-022: The Billing Service shall allow a Librarian to waive overdue fines up to $25.00 USD after entering a mandatory reason code in the audit log; waivers above $25.00 USD require Administrator approval.
original_texts.SD-023: The Notification Service shall dispatch SMS due-date alerts 24 hours before the due timestamp to all Members who have opted into SMS notifications.
original_texts.SD-024: The Billing Service shall delete archived payment receipts after 7 years in accordance with the library retention policy.
original_texts.SD-025: The Billing Service shall calculate late fees at $0.50 USD per day with a $20.00 USD maximum cap.
original_texts.SD-026: The Circulation System shall block online renewals when a Member's unpaid fine balance exceeds $5.00 USD.
original_texts.SD-027: The Circulation System shall display a Member's active loan list, due dates, and current fine balance on the account summary screen within 1 second.
original_texts.SD-028: The Catalog Search Service shall return paginated results of 25 items per page within 800 milliseconds under a sustained load of 500 concurrent queries.
original_texts.SD-029: The Catalog Search Service shall highlight exact matched query terms inside title and abstract snippets using HTML <mark> tags when query length is between 2 and 100 characters.
original_texts.SD-030: The Catalog Search Service shall normalize ISBN-10 and ISBN-13 search strings by stripping hyphens and spaces, and return matching bibliographic records within 500 milliseconds.
original_texts.SD-031: The Catalog Import Service shall process batch MARC21 files up to 50,000 records within 5 minutes and quarantine malformed records into an error CSV report.
original_texts.SD-032: When a Librarian deletes a bibliographic record that still has active loans or holds, the Catalog Service shall block deletion and return error ERR-CAT-INUSE.
original_texts.SD-034: The Backup Service shall execute an encrypted full database backup daily at 02:00 UTC and verify checksum integrity; backup failures shall trigger an alert to the Administrator within 5 minutes.
original_texts.SD-035: The Audit Service shall log all Librarian and Administrator privilege changes within 1 second and retain logs in append-only storage for 365 days.
original_texts.SD-036: If the primary database node becomes unreachable for more than 10 seconds, the Failover Manager shall promote the synchronous standby replica within 30 seconds and log event FAILOVER-01.
original_texts.SD-037: The Portal Interface shall restrict Member login pages to TLS 1.3 and display clear error codes for expired certificates within 3 seconds.
original_texts.SD-038: The Authentication Service shall enforce a minimum password length of 12 characters.
original_texts.SD-039: The Authentication Service shall automatically log out inactive web portal users after 15 minutes.
original_texts.SD-040: The Authentication Service shall hash Member and Librarian passwords using bcrypt.
